User clarified after failed bs116 formal run: “>70g 就可以。这个问题不大。直接进 execute 吧.” Treat this as explicit approval to relax the formal GPU memory target from >90% to >70GB observed memory, prioritizing stable zero-OOM canonical checkpoint over >90% VRAM. Proceed directly to L4 execute.

Prior execute evidence: bs112 smoke passed with 0 OOM, 1 optimizer step, peak 73127 MiB / 81559 MiB (~89.7%, >70GB). bs116 smoke passed but formal bs116 failed with 1 CUDA OOM skip and no valid checkpoint. Do not reuse failed checkpoint. Do not use bs116/bs128 unless executor has strong evidence; default formal retry should use bs112, grad_accum 1, top_k 8, lr 5e-6, 1 epoch, DPO warm start checkpoints/dpo_model/stage1_final, data data/stage2_safeopd_taxrisk_5k_train.json, manifest data/stage2_safeopd_taxrisk_5k_manifest.json, conda env mjy. Fresh run/checkpoint name should distinguish retry, e.g. llama31_safeopd_taxrisk_5k_bs112_r20260508_retry.

Execute objectives:
1. Validate routed data/manifest and reuse prior smoke evidence or rerun minimal validation as needed. State estimated wall-clock runtime and basis before formal launch; record process/log/output paths and polling/audit timing.
2. Run formal Taxonomy/Risk-Gated SafeOPD training at bs112 with >70GB observed memory target, zero CUDA OOM skips required, expected optimizer steps required, fresh checkpoint/log names, no use of failed bs116 checkpoint as comparator.
3. If formal training succeeds and checkpoint is valid, proceed to generation for model set: base, base_with_stage2_context, valid OPD llama31_s1dpo_opd5k_bs112_r20260507_retry_070014@stage2_final, new taxrisk checkpoint, SafeDPO safedpo_5k_from_general_dpo_20260506@safe_dpo_final. Benchmarks: HarmBench, XSTest, StrongREJECT, Arena-Hard. Use generation-only entrypoints; no scoring mixed into generation.
4. Run new safety-only LLM judge src/evaluate_safety_llm_judge.py on generated safety artifacts using docs/apikey.txt/env securely. Do not print/copy/log secrets. Output per-item judgments, aggregate safety metrics, manifest, parse/empty counts. Labels are safety/refusal/harmful-compliance/over-refusal only; no answer quality.
5. Run reward/helpfulness scoring only for answer quality/general ability using local reward paths where applicable. Do not report reward as safety.
6. If feasible, run paired/bootstrap/statistical comparison or produce complete per-item outputs for later bootstrap.
7. Postrun audit: command identities, manifests, route counts, checkpoint validity, bs112 vs prior bs116 evidence, GPU memory >70GB, OOM/data skips, generation coverage, LLM judge coverage/parse failures, reward coverage, deprecated judge paths not used, no secret leakage.

Strict invariants: conda env mjy only; no venv/dependency install; no deletion of checkpoints/logs; no deprecated evaluate.py --eval or evaluate_arena.py --judge/--judge-all; no chat-template migration; no invalid bs128 OPD comparator; preserve safety/reward metric separation.

Completion: stay open until terminal state and postrun audit. If training succeeds but later API/generation/reward stage blocks, return partial with valid checkpoint evidence and exact blocked stage. If long generation/judge cannot complete inside one bridge, report owned process refs/status rather than claiming completion.
